name: Inventory retracement bar
note: Hoffman's IRB. In an uptrend (close above SMA(n) and that SMA rising over slope_n bars) a wide bar whose ENTIRE real body sits in the bottom `wick` of its range is counter-trend inventory; trading through its high proves the selling was absorbed, so the signal fires on the first of the next `valid` bars whose high exceeds the signal bar's high by a tick. Mirror for shorts. Hoffman's unquantifiable '45-degree MA angle' is replaced by an explicit SMA slope test, as the source note requires. The resting stop order is approximated by the harness's next-open fill, which is one bar later than a real stop fill.
source: Rob Hoffman's Inventory Retracement Bar. The 45% threshold and the 20-period MA trend filter as implemented in https://github.com/m-marqx/Inventory.Retracement.Bar.APP (signal when the wick reaches 45%, 20-period SMA trend filter, entry on a break of the signal candle's extreme, target as a payoff multiple of the signal candle's amplitude, stop at the signal candle's extreme) and the open-source TradingView implementations (e.g. script khxEdmoy, 'Rob Hoffman Inventory Retracement Bar', which computes x = low + 0.45*(high-low) and signals when open and close are both beyond x). Hoffman's original '45-degree MA angle' filter is unquantifiable and is replaced here with an explicit SMA slope test.

def family_init(ctx):
    import indicators as I
    bars = ctx.bars
    n = len(bars)
    o = [float(b["o"]) for b in bars]
    h = [float(b["h"]) for b in bars]
    l = [float(b["l"]) for b in bars]
    c = [float(b["c"]) for b in bars]
    at = I.compute("atr", bars, period=int(ctx.p.atr_n))["atr"]

    p = max(2, int(ctx.p.ma_n))
    ma = [None] * n
    run = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        run += c[i]
        if i >= p:
            run -= c[i - p]
        if i >= p - 1:
            ma[i] = run / p

    sl = max(1, int(ctx.p.slope_n))
    w = float(ctx.p.wick)
    ka = float(ctx.p.min_atr)
    kind = [0] * n
    for i in range(sl, n):
        m, m0, a = ma[i], ma[i - sl], at[i]
        if m is None or m0 is None or a is None or a <= 0:
            continue
        rng = h[i] - l[i]
        if rng <= 0 or rng < ka * a:
            continue
        bh = c[i] if c[i] > o[i] else o[i]
        bl = c[i] if c[i] < o[i] else o[i]
        if c[i] > m and m > m0 and bh <= l[i] + w * rng:
            kind[i] = 1                      # body pinned to the low, uptrend
        elif c[i] < m and m < m0 and bl >= h[i] - w * rng:
            kind[i] = -1

    val = max(1, int(ctx.p.valid))
    tick = float(ctx.p.tick)
    sig = [0.0] * n
    for i in range(1, n):
        for j in range(i - 1, max(-1, i - val - 1), -1):
            if kind[j] == 1 and h[i] > h[j] + tick:
                sig[i] = 1.0
                break
            if kind[j] == -1 and l[i] < l[j] - tick:
                sig[i] = -1.0
                break
    ctx.sig = ctx.series(sig, "irb")


def signal(ctx, i):
    s = ctx.sig[i]
    if not s:
        return 0
    return 1 if s > 0 else -1
